components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.75rem; font-family: var(--display, "Literata", Didot, serif); font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; font-variation-settings: "opsz" 28; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgb(60 5 15 / 0.3); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 200ms; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #ebca7e); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary { color: var(--gold, #ebca7e); background: var(--satin, #a80f29); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--satin-deep, #6e0919); }

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.75rem; font-family: var(--display, "Literata", Didot, serif); font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; font-variation-settings: "opsz" 28; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgb(60 5 15 / 0.3); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 200ms; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #ebca7e); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-red { padding: 2rem; background: var(--satin-deep, #6e0919); } .ds-btn-gold { text-decoration: none; color: var(--satin-ink, #2a050c); background: var(--gold, #ebca7e); } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: var(--gold-soft, #f3dfa9); }

components.name: Ribbon Band
components.description: The form surface: tilted full-bleed cotton band with a dashed old-gold selvedge and the live gold stamp. Hover stands in for the done state, when the band straightens.
components.html: Lucía Pérez14 · 03 · 1992
components.css: .ds-ground { padding: 2.5rem 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--satin, #a80f29); } .ds-ribbon { width: calc(100% + 6rem); margin-inline: -3rem; background: var(--cotton, #fdfaf7); border-block: 0.6rem solid var(--cotton, #fdfaf7); outline: 1px dashed var(--gold-deep, #8a6420); outline-offset: -0.35rem; transform: rotate(-1.2deg); transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-ribbon:hover, .ds-ribbon:hover .ds-ribbon-inner { transform: rotate(0deg); } .ds-ribbon-inner { max-width: 34rem; margin-inline: auto; padding: 1.25rem 1rem; transform: rotate(1.2deg); transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-stamp { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 0.15rem; text-align: center; } .ds-stamp-name { font-family: var(--display, "Literata", Didot, serif); font-weight: 700; font-variation-settings: "opsz" 48; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold-deep, #8a6420); } .ds-stamp-date { font-family: var(--display, "Literata", Didot, serif); font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: var(--gold-deep, #8a6420); }

components.name: Wish Chain
components.description: Anonymous cotton ribbon pieces joined by old-gold knots, swallowtail-cut at both ends, with the gold count beneath.
components.html: Ya somos 6 deseos en la cinta
components.css: .ds-chain-wrap { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 2rem 1rem; background: var(--satin, #a80f29); font-family: var(--text, Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-chain { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; row-gap: 0.75rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-chain li { position: relative; width: 2.25rem; height: 1.75rem; background: var(--cotton, #fdfaf7); } .ds-chain li::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 0.2rem; top: 50%; width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; margin-top: -0.25rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gold-deep, #8a6420); } .ds-chain li:first-child { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 0.6rem 50%); } .ds-chain li:last-child { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 0.6rem) 50%, 100% 100%, 0 100%); animation: ds-tie 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; transform-origin: left center; } .ds-chain li:last-child::after { display: none; } @keyframes ds-tie { from { transform: scaleX(0); background: var(--gold, #ebca7e); } to { transform: none; } } .ds-counter { margin: 0; color: var(--gold-soft, #f3dfa9); } .ds-counter strong { font-family: var(--display, "Literata", Didot, serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.6em; color: var(--gold, #ebca7e); }

components.css: .ds-closing { display: grid; justify-items: center; padding: 3rem 1rem; background: var(--satin-deep, #6e0919); } .ds-photo { position: relative; width: min(80%, 16rem); margin: 0; padding: 0.6rem 0.6rem 2.25rem; background: var(--cotton, #fdfaf7); transform: rotate(2.5deg); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgb(20 2 6 / 0.45); } .ds-photo-img { aspect-ratio: 900 / 963; background: var(--cotton-shade, #ece4dc); } .ds-pin { display: block; height: auto; overflow: visible; } .ds-photo-pin { position: absolute; top: -1rem; left: 50%; z-index: 1; width: 7rem; color: var(--gold, #ebca7e); transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-10deg); }

components.name: Safety Pin
components.description: The single ornament glyph: a line-drawn safety pin in currentColor, stamped gold on red, old gold on cotton.
components.css: .ds-pins { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } .ds-pins > span { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 2rem 1rem; } .ds-on-red { background: var(--satin, #a80f29); color: var(--gold, #ebca7e); } .ds-on-cotton { background: var(--cotton, #fdfaf7); color: var(--gold-deep, #8a6420); } .ds-pin { width: 7rem; height: auto; overflow: visible; transform: rotate(-8deg); }

narrative.overview:
Every surface is a length of souvenir ribbon. The ground is flat satin red, type is hot-stamped gold, and the working material (the form, the admin sheet, the photo mount) is white cotton laid across the red. Nothing imitates a material with gradients, gloss, or emboss. Satin is a flat field, gold is a flat ink, and the illusion comes from composition: a band that tilts and runs off both edges of the screen, a dashed stitch along its selvedge, a gold safety pin fastening things down.

The page is a single centered column, generous on red and dense on cotton. Display type is Literata, set heavy and large, often in caps, the way names are stamped on a christening ribbon. Body copy is Figtree, plain and warm. Motion is physical and brief: the band straightens when it is pinned, a stamped name settles as if pressed, and a new piece of ribbon unrolls into the chain.

The confirmed rejection is the pastel baby-shower card: no watercolor, no flowers, no illustration, no emoji.
keyCharacteristics: Flat satin red ground with a deeper red closing band and footer.
Gold leaf as flat color, never foil, sheen, or emboss.
White cotton band, tilted -1.2deg, full bleed, with a dashed gold selvedge stitch.
Literata display in caps for stamped moments; Figtree for reading and fields.
A line-drawn gold safety pin as the single ornament glyph.
A chain of anonymous cotton ribbon pieces with gold knots, one per wish.

rules.name: The Flat Ink Rule
rules.body: Red and gold are flat fills. There are no gradients, metallic sheens, or highlight overlays anywhere in the build. Gold reads as gold through its value against red, not through faked reflection.

rules.name: The Two Golds Rule
rules.body: Gold on red uses Stamped Gold or Pale Gold. Gold on cotton uses Old Gold. Never put light gold on white.

rules.name: The Stamping Rule
rules.body: Literata in caps is reserved for things that are stamped: the title, a participant's name, and the call to action. Sentences stay in sentence case, even when they are set in Literata.

rules.name: The Optical Size Rule
rules.body: The principal Literata settings declare an `opsz` that matches their rendered size: 72 for the masthead (Literata opsz max), 72 for the section headline and closing line, 48 for the stamp, 36 for the confirmation title, and 28 for the button. New display settings follow this scale.

rules.name: The Laid-On Rule
rules.body: Only objects that are physically laid on the ribbon cast a shadow: a button, a pinned photo, a sheet. The band and the chain stay flat.

dos: **Do** keep red and gold flat. Express gold on red with Stamped Gold (#ebca7e) and gold on cotton with Old Gold (#8a6420).
**Do** put working content (forms, lists, photos) on cotton laid over red, and keep red for the ground and the stamped type.
**Do** set stamped moments (title, names, call to action) in Literata caps with an `opsz` that matches the rendered size, and set reading copy in Figtree.
**Do** use the safety pin SVG, in `currentColor`, when something needs fastening or confirming.
**Do** keep tilts small (between -10deg and 2.5deg) and straighten the band when the user completes the form.
**Do** keep public fields at least 3rem tall and the primary action at 3.5rem.
donts: **Don't** imitate foil, emboss, or satin sheen with gradients, highlights, or texture images.
**Don't** add flowers, watercolor, illustrations, or emoji. The pastel baby-shower card is the confirmed anti-reference.
**Don't** introduce a second decorative glyph alongside the safety pin.
**Don't** put light gold (#ebca7e or #f3dfa9) on cotton, where it loses legibility.
**Don't** put names, initials, or other text on chain pieces. Each piece is a plain cotton length with a knot.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows or neutral gray shadows. Shadows are soft, tinted dark red, and reserved for laid-on objects.
